component.name: Linxira Hardware and Driver Manager
component.summary: Inspect hardware and review fixed driver policy plans

description.p: Reports detector facts, installed driver state, supported kernel compatibility, DKMS status, initramfs state, and reboot effects.
Creates reviewable driver plans and root-owned receipts. Hyper-V, QEMU, and VMware guest tools can be applied after a required Timeshift snapshot; other driver changes remain unavailable.
